jobs.title: Lead, Strategic Finance - Deals (International)
jobs.description:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.


ABOUT THE TEAM

Strategic Finance is the commercial and analytical engine behind Snowflake's product and revenue decisions. The team operates at the intersection of product strategy, pricing, and investment prioritization. Strategic Engagements, the function this role sits within, owns Snowflake's most consequential customer pursuits, partnerships, and M&A engagements. We bring financial, product, market, and pricing depth to the deals that determine quarters, set commercial precedent, and shape Snowflake's largest customer relationships.




ABOUT THE ROLE

We are hiring an International Strategic Engagements Deal Lead to own the commercial structuring and execution of Snowflake's most consequential customer engagements outside North America. You will be the in-region point person for Strategic Engagements across EMEA, APAC, and other international markets, providing time-zone coverage, local commercial relationships, and regional commercial structuring expertise that the NoAM-based team cannot deliver remotely.

You will own the deal-by-deal economic frame, commercial recommendation, and structuring approach for qualifying international engagements across the full deal portfolio: net-new logo acquisitions, installed-base expansions, partnership-driven structures, and precedent-setting deals. You will partner directly with regional account leadership, Specialist Sales, AI Specialists, regional Deal Desk, regional Legal, regional Revenue Accounting, and the central Strategic Engagements team. You will join customer conversations on qualifying deals, particularly with senior customer stakeholders (CFO, COO, CIO, CPO).




IN THIS ROLE YOU WILL

 - Own International Deal Economics. Build the deal-by-deal economic frame for qualifying international engagements. Workload mix, capacity sizing, multi-year ramp, hybrid AI structures, multi-product economics, and competitive positioning. Translate the frame into a clear commercial recommendation that accounts for regional commercial realities.

 - Lead Regional Commercial Structuring. Lead pricing and commercial structuring across capacity, consumption, hybrid AI, and multi-product deal structures. Bring regional competitive benchmarks, willingness-to-pay context, and unit economics into structuring conversations. Navigate multi-currency exposure, regional revenue recognition treatment, sovereignty constraints, and local commercial conventions.

 - Provide Time-Zone Coverage. Be the in-region escalation point for live deals. Drive cross-functional decisions to closure on regional time, without waiting for NoAM business hours.

 - Build Local Relationships. Build and maintain the regional cross-functional relationships (regional Deal Desk, Legal, Revenue Accounting, AI Specialists, Sales leadership) that allow Strategic Engagements to execute at speed in your markets.

 - Shape Commercial Outcomes. Shape the commercial strategy, sequencing, and economic frame that gives the account team the strongest path to win acquisition deals at defensible terms and to protect margin discipline on expansion deals. Deal outcomes are jointly owned with the account team; you own the Snowflake-side commercial frame and recommendation.

 - Run Concession Discipline. Track concessions live against tiered margin-dilution thresholds. Escalate structural concessions (renewal caps, evergreen discounts, affiliate-use extensions, termination-for-convenience, multi-year ramp giveaways) regardless of size. Gate signature on a passed readiness check.

 - Coach the Field. Coach regional AEs on package strategy, negotiation sequencing, and how to position the deal. Bring the Strategic Engagements playbook into the field engagement, adapted for regional commercial norms.

 - Engage Customers Directly. Join customer conversations on qualifying deals with senior customer stakeholders. The account team owns the customer relationship and close authority. You bring the commercial, financial, and pricing depth into the room.

 - Adhere to the Deal Playbook. Run every deal in line with Strategic Engagements playbook standards: financial controls (booking accuracy, revenue recognition, concession tracking), deal process discipline, system requirements (CRM, contract management, billing), and legal compliance.

 - Operate AI-Native by Default. Use AI-assisted workflows for deal-economics modeling, redline triage, stakeholder synthesis, recommendation drafting, and competitive benchmarking. AI is a default execution mode, not an enhancement layer.

 - Build the Repeatable Playbook. Feed lessons from every closed international deal back into qualification criteria, regional commercial structuring patterns, fallback library, and lifecycle artifacts. Calibrate the playbook quarterly through the Strategic Engagements postmortem.

 - Communicate to Executives. Produce the recommendation memos, daily deal update notes, and quarterly postmortem materials that connect deal status, commercial structure, key risks, and decisions in flight to executive sponsors and the CFO when material.


WHAT YOU WILL NEED


REQUIRED

 - 10+ years of experience in strategic finance, deal desk, pricing, commercial operations, sales finance, investment banking, or equivalent commercial roles, with a track record of structuring complex international commercial deals at a scaling technology company.

 - Demonstrated experience structuring large enterprise commercial deals across multiple international markets: multi-year capacity, consumption commitments, hybrid commercial structures, multi-currency exposure, and multi-product agreements. Comfort with deals greater than $75M TCV.

 - High agency and standalone execution. You can run a deal end-to-end with minimal management overhead, including across time zones from the central team. You define your own structure, generate your own scaffolding, and drive your own decisions to closure.

 - Deep regional commercial fluency. Working knowledge of regional pricing dynamics, revenue recognition treatment, sovereignty and regulatory constraints, and the relational and commercial norms of enterprise software in your region.

 - Strong financial modeling skills. Ability to build deal economic models, scenario analyses, sensitivity analyses, and concession ledgers that connect commercial structure to economic outcome.

 - Working understanding of cloud and software-as-a-service commercial models: pricing and packaging, billing and metering, revenue recognition, commercial contracting, and post-signature operations.

 - Customer-facing presence. Comfort engaging senior customer stakeholders (CFO, COO, CIO, CPO) on commercial structure, pricing, and economics, in-region.

 - Effective communicator. Capable of translating complex commercial structure into clean executive narratives, running productive multi-stakeholder meetings across time zones, and driving alignment in writing.

 - AI-native disposition. Comfortable using AI-assisted workflows for deal modeling, redline triage, stakeholder synthesis, and recommendation drafting as part of how you work.

 - Comfort with ambiguity. Willingness to operate on precedent-setting deals where commercial mechanics are not yet standardized.

 - Bachelor's degree in Finance, Economics, Computer Science, Engineering, or related discipline. MBA or advanced degree preferred.


PREFERRED

 - Hands-on experience structuring international deals at a high-growth cloud, data, AI, or SaaS company.

 - Established commercial relationships with regional Deal Desk, Legal, and Revenue Accounting at a major cloud or SaaS company.

 - Familiarity with consumption-based and usage-based pricing in cloud, data, or AI platforms.

 - Familiarity with regional revenue accounting nuances (e.g., IFRS 15 alongside ASC 606), SOX controls, and audit-ready process design.

 - Experience with competitive pricing analysis and willingness-to-pay research, particularly across multiple regional markets.

 - Multilingual professional fluency, where applicable to the region of focus.

 - SQL fluency or comfort working directly with commercial data in a cloud data platform.

Snowflake's Corporate Development team operates across acquisitions, strategic investments, and partnerships - and as that activity scales, so does the need for strong operational infrastructure across the full lifecycle. We are seeking a Corporate Development Operations & M&A Integration Lead to own diligence support and integration execution, build the systems and processes that make the team run, and maintain visibility across our Snowflake Ventures portfolio.



The scope spans Corporate Development operations, including M&A diligence and integration, and portfolio oversight. This is a high-impact role for someone who is equally comfortable driving a complex diligence process and post-close integration and building the playbooks and tooling that make the next one faster. You bring structure to ambiguous situations, communicate clearly across all levels of the organization, and are energized by leveraging AI to build systems that scale.



What You Will Be Doing



 - M&A Diligence & Integration
   
   - Bring an integration and operational lens into the diligence process. This includes evaluating organizational fit, identifying integration risks, reviewing operational readiness, and flagging issues that should inform deal structure or timing. Coordinate cross-functional diligence workstreams and help synthesize findings into clear recommendations for deal leads
   
   - Own integration planning and execution for acquisitions from late-stage diligence through steady state (including change management, employee retention planning, and cultural transition) translating the deal thesis into clear functional plans, owners, milestones, risks and decision points
   
   - Partner closely with the GTM Operations team on commercial integration workstreams, ensuring alignment between deal intent and field execution
   
   - Track integration KPIs and synergy realization against the original deal thesis, reporting milestones/progress, risks, blockers and recommendations to deal sponsors and executive leadership
   
   - Run integration retrospectives and feed lessons learned back into future diligence, term sheet assumptions, and integration planning



 - Corporate Development Operations
   
   - Build and maintain the operational infrastructure that supports the full corporate development function - deal pipeline processes, diligence templates, integration playbooks, and the data and AI tools that give the team better visibility and faster execution across all transaction types
   
   - Apply AI-enabled workflows using Snowflake and AI software to standardize and improve integration planning, playbooks, governance cadences, and reusable templates for future transactions



 - Cross-Functional Program Management
   
   - Serve as the bridge between deal teams and the broader organization during active diligence and integration processes - managing dependencies, driving decisions, and keeping complex multi-stakeholder workstreams on track



 - Snowflake Ventures Portfolio Management
   
   - Help identify opportunities for portfolio companies to deepen product, go-to-market, or ecosystem alignment with Snowflake
   
   - Support and manage the Snowflake Ventures portfolio - including QBRs, coordination with Tech Alliances on partnership opportunities, accounting and financial reporting oversight, and identifying synergies with Snowflake's product and go-to-market motion



What You Bring

 - 7+ years of experience in corporate development, hands-on M&A integration, or management consulting with a technology focus

 - Demonstrated track record leading end-to-end M&A integrations across multiple transaction types including acqui-hires, platform acquisitions, asset purchases and mergers

 - Strong program management skills with the ability to hold complex, multi-stakeholder workstreams on track without direct authority

 - Clear, concise communication with executives, functional partners, and founders showing ability to manage senior stakeholders

 - Familiarity with data and AI tools and a deep interest in building more efficient, instrumented ways of working

 - Background in software, cloud, data, AI or enterprise SaaS, with an understanding of commercial integration activities such as customer transition, contract migration, sales coverage, GTM systems, customer success handoff and field execution.

 - Experience working alongside or coordinating with GTM and sales operations teams on enterprise go-to-market integration activities

 - Experience managing or monitoring a portfolio of strategic investments



You Will Thrive In This Role If

 - You have led integrations before and know where integrations usually break down

 - You are equally comfortable in an executive steering committee, a founder transition conversation, and a detailed workstream review

 - You can spot integration risks during diligence, before they become post-close problems

 - You are comfortable pushing functional leaders for clarity while maintaining trust and credibility

 - You can translate a strategic deal rationale into a practical execution plan

 - You like building systems that make future work faster and more repeatable

ABOUT THE TEAM

Strategic Finance is where Snowflake's biggest financial questions get answered: what an acquisition is worth, where the company lands over the long term, what our EPS looks like, and how much capital each entity needs. Our work doesn't end at the model — we translate what the numbers say into clear points of view that help the CFO and senior leadership act.



ABOUT THE ROLE

This is a high-visibility role spanning corporate development, long-term planning, and technical accounting — a combination that's rare for a single analyst seat. You will build serious financial models and provide real decision-driving support to the executive level. This role is best suited for candidates from investment banking, private equity, or FP&A who are ready to work across M&A diligence, forecasting, and EPS simultaneously. You will work closely with a Senior Manager who owns methodology and will teach it.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

Financial Storytelling

Turn model output into a clear narrative for executive and board audiences — the headline, the key drivers, and the recommendation. Build exec summaries, ELT slides, and briefing memos where every number is defensible, and present your analysis directly to senior finance leadership.

M&A Diligence and Deal Modeling

Dive into target financials to understand unit economics, cost structure, and the operating model. Build acquisition models under the direction of the deal lead: standalone and pro forma projections, purchase price allocation, accretion/dilution, and sensitivity cases framed around what has to be true for the deal to work.

Long-Term Planning and 3-Statement Forecasting

Maintain and extend the total-company long-term model — full P&L, balance sheet, and cash flow — driven off bookings, revenue, headcount, and cost-per-head. Run scenarios and translate trade-offs into terms leadership can act on: growth versus margin, hiring pace versus operating leverage.

SBC and EPS Modeling

Run the monthly stock-based compensation forecast, including grant-level expense attribution, new-grant and refresh assumptions, and forfeitures by function and legal entity. Build quarterly and annual basic and diluted EPS forecasts using treasury stock method mechanics and share count roll-forward.

Entity-Level Cash Flow and Capital Planning

Build entity-level cash flow forecasts to size capital requirements and funding needs across international subsidiaries. Support Tax on transfer pricing analytics and convert entity-level detail into a plain funding recommendation: which entities need cash, how much, and when.



WHAT YOU WILL NEED

• 1–3 years of experience in investment banking, private equity, corporate development, transaction advisory, or corporate FP&A

• Ability to build or work extensively in a 3-statement operating model, and explain how the balance sheet and cash flow tie

• Familiarity with M&A modeling mechanics — accretion/dilution, purchase accounting, sources and uses

• Advanced Excel with disciplined model structure and a bias toward auditability over cleverness

• Strong written and verbal communication — able to take a complex analysis and land it in three sentences and one slide

• Solid GAAP fundamentals with genuine interest in SBC (ASC 718) and EPS (ASC 260)

• Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field, or equivalent experience



Bonus Points

• Experience building materials for a CFO, board, or executive audience

• SQL proficiency, or a clear appetite to learn — this team queries the data warehouse directly

• Workday Adaptive Planning or a comparable EPM platform

• Entity-level cash flow, capital adequacy, or transfer pricing exposure

• Python for model automation

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Strategy & Operations, Global Revenue Enablement
jobs.description:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

The Global Revenue Enablement (GRE) organization exists to equip every audience in our go-to-market ecosystem—field, partners and customers —with the clarity, systems, and operational leverage they need to execute with machine speed and absolute consistency.

Within frontier AI and high-velocity cloud environments, enablement is fundamentally a systems engineering and operational discipline. Sitting at the nexus of GRE and our Technology & Systems engineering organizations, this Principal TPM serves as the operational architect for our revenue machine. Your mandate is to design, orchestrate, and institutionalize GTM processes built on AI-first principles—eliminating manual friction, automating complex quote-to-cash workflows, and building scalable rails for rapid commercialization.

We are looking for an exceptional Principal TPM who combines top-tier portfolio governance with deep technical, systems, and operational fluency. You operate as an internal principal consultant, systems strategist, and execution engine.

You will partner hand-in-glove with GRE’s Technology & Systems, the Enterprise Technology Team and Data Analytics and AI team, to translate commercial growth strategies into deterministic, automated systems. You will lead high-stakes, enterprise-wide initiatives.

You thrive in high-ambiguity environments, bring order to complex multi-quarter roadmaps, surface critical architectural trade-offs, and align executive stakeholders without needing direct authority.



IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL:

 - Design AI-Native Workflows: Partner directly with Technology & Systems engineering to audit, rebuild, and operationalize field and enablement workflows using frontier AI models, automated agents, and intelligent orchestration pipelines throughout the organization.

 - Eliminate Operational Friction: Systematically dismantle manual bottlenecks across the GRE’s lifecycles, e.g. team to team handoffs, vendor relationships, technical business requirements scoping, and enablement content.

 - Intelligent Tooling Deployment: Act as the lead technical sponsor for evaluating, piloting, and standardizing tool stack based on GRE priorities. 

 - Drive High-Impact Projects via Scrum: Lead and execute mission-critical technical programs using rigorous Scrum and Agile methodologies—running sprint planning, backlog prioritization, cross-functional standups, and retrospectives to ensure predictable, high-velocity delivery across distributed GRE teams

 - Enablement as a Product: Treat operational enablement as an engineering-grade platform. Establish program telemetry, operational SLAs, and feedback loops to measure ramp time, operational velocity, and release velocity

 - Portfolio Strategy & Intake: Run the strategic intake and prioritization engine for Technology & Systems team, filtering unstructured business demands into rigorous, measurable delivery roadmaps aligned to top-line outcomes.

 - Executive Program Alignment: Coordinate and drive alignment cross-functionally across teams, managing communications, milestone delivery, and critical risk mitigations.

 - Quote-to-Cash Optimization: Drive the multi-quarter technical program roadmap conversations for CPQ architecture (Salesforce) to accelerate GRE’s service/deal structuring.

 - Packaging & Pricing Execution: Partner with Head of Customer Activation and lead the technical operationalization of enablement services/packaging, and API pricing models.

 - Governance Automation: Partner with Finance, Legal, and Deal Desk to codify pricing rules, custom discounting thresholds, and contractual guardrails into automated rules engines, dramatically reducing manual approval cycle times.

 - Downstream Systems Interoperability: Ensure seamless data synchronization across LMS, CRM, CPQ  and usage-metering infrastructure for real-time contracting and provisioning.

 - Operational Readiness: Ensure all systems (CRM, CPQ, billing, product telemetry, and field enablement repositories) are fully configured, tested, and validated prior to any public or gated release.
   
    


REQUIRED SKILLS:

 - 10+ years of technical program management, business operations, or revenue systems leadership within high-growth technology, SaaS, or frontier AI environments.

 - Proven IC5 Track Record: Demonstrated ability to drive multi-quarter enterprise programs across diverse teams (Engineering, Product, Legal, Finance, and Sales) with minimal direction.

 - AI-First Fluency: Practical understanding of modern LLM APIs and agentic workflow orchestration.

 - Deep Systems Fluency: Advanced expertise in the revenue technology stack: Salesforce (Enterprise CRM/CPQ) and data warehouses (Snowflake, BigQuery).

 - Analytical Rigor: Ability in querying  to derive insights and validate program ROI.
   
    

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?
